title: Regularity of a Quadratic Boolean Function
statement: Let $n$ be an even natural number, and define $Q(x)=\sum_{1\le i<j\le n}x_i x_j$ over $\mathbb F_2$ for $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Regard the indicator of $Q(x)=1$ as a real-valued function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ via the coordinatewise identification of bits with signs. Every nonempty-set Fourier coefficient of this function has absolute value at most $2^{-(n/2+1)}$.
